The ticket repair is saved and verified: acme/widgets#77 now reads "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." That row is `in-scope`, and the design will add the setting's default in `settings/resolver.ts:12` and read it in `ui/report-view.ts:30`.

Today, filters stay active after a workspace switch and can hide rows in the new workspace. What should the report view do with active filters when the workspace changes?

A) Reset all filters on every workspace change. The new setting controls this and defaults to on.
B) Reset all filters only when the setting is turned on. It defaults to off, so current behavior stays the default.
C) Keep filters that still apply in the new workspace and drop the ones that do not. The setting turns this pruning on or off.
other - name it

Recommendation: A - the reported problem is stale filters hiding rows after a switch, and defaulting to reset fixes that for every user while the setting still lets someone keep their filters.
